description: This file implements the core logic for verifying OpenID Connect ID tokens, including signature verification, claim validation, and token parsing. It defines key interfaces, verifier construction, and token validation functions.

classes.name: IDTokenVerifier
classes.description: Provides verification for ID tokens, including signature validation and claim checks.

methods.name: NewVerifier
methods.description: Constructs a new IDTokenVerifier with specified issuer URL, key set, and configuration.

methods.name: Verify
methods.description: Verifies a raw ID token string, checking signature, issuer, audience, expiry, and other claims.
